elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor must make transition assistance available to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3 applies upon expiry or termination and requires Vendor, at Customer's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(a) expressly provides assistance for up to six months.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(a) expressly applies Vendor's then-current rates.

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor must return or make available for export all Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The data-return obligation arises only upon Customer's request, so expiry or termination alone does not trigger return or export.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned or made available for export within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The 30-day period runs from Customer's request rather than from expiry or termination; a later or absent request can delay the export indefinitely.

elements.element: Customer Data must be provided in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(b) requires a commonly used, machine-readable format, which satisfies this format requirement.

elements.element: After return or export, Vendor must delete all Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(c) permits Customer Data to remain in routine backups and under legal retention requirements, while the preferred position contains no such exceptions or eventual-deletion obligation.

elements.element: After deletion, Vendor must certify the deletion.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(c) requires Vendor thereafter to certify the deletion in writing, although the underlying deletion is qualified by retention exceptions.

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor must make transition assistance available to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(a) makes transition assistance available at Customer's request following expiry or termination.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: The obligation to provide assistance for up to six months encompasses a Customer request for a 90-day assistance period.

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor must export or make available for export all Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(b) conditions the export obligation on a Customer request rather than making expiry or termination sufficient to trigger it.

elements.element: Customer Data must be exported or made available for export within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause measures the 30-day deadline from Customer's request, not from expiry or termination.

result.reason: Neither level is complete because the data-export duty and 30-day deadline are conditioned and measured by Customer's request rather than expiry or termination. The preferred level also lacks unqualified deletion of all Customer Data. The targeted transition terms otherwise preserve the original clause and do not contradict unrelated commercial terms.
